title: Open Project Run for launch or QA sandbox
instructions: Create a Project Runs row: Run Type = New Site Launch (production intent) or QA Sandbox (test-only). Set Launch Key (stable string), External ID (csn:{site}:{launch}), link SOP Version = Active, Status = In progress, Current Phase = 1.
prerequisites: Active SOP Versions row exists. Operator knows Launch Key naming convention.
expectedOutput: Project Run page linked to SOP Version with Started date populated.
acceptanceCriteria: Run Name, Launch Key, External ID, and SOP Version relation are non-empty; Evidence URL empty until Phase 10+.
requiredEvidence: Screenshot or URL of Project Run row in Notion.
completionCondition: Project Run Status is In progress and Current Phase = 1.

title: Create or link CSN Sites row
instructions: Create CSN Sites row: Site Name, Domain (URL), Record Class = Production OR QA test-only, Launch Key matches Project Run, External ID matches run scope. Relate Site on Project Run.
expectedOutput: CSN Sites row with correct Record Class and relations to Project Run.
acceptanceCriteria: QA test-only sites must never use Record Class = Production.
requiredEvidence: CSN Sites row URL in Project Run notes or Evidence URL field on run.
completionCondition: Project Run → Site relation points to intended site row.

title: Request scoped Human Gate for run intake
instructions: Create Human Gates row: Target Type = project_run, Target External ID = Project Run External ID, Scope lists allowed work (e.g. Notion ops only), Limits (max spend $0 for QA). Status = Pending until approver sets Approved.
expectedOutput: Pending Human Gate uniquely tied to this run (not blanket approval).
acceptanceCriteria: Gate Scope and Limits mention exact run/site; no other targets referenced as approved.
requiredEvidence: Human Gates row URL; approver name when Approved.
completionCondition: Gate Status = Approved for sandbox QA; Pending acceptable for production until human acts.

title: expireddomains.net search and export
instructions: Go to https://www.expireddomains.net/ → Deleted Domains. Apply filters (TLD, length, no adult-blocked TLDs per policy). Export candidate list. For each candidate create Domain Candidates row: Source = expireddomains.net, Domain title, link Site + Project Run, Status = Not started.
prerequisites: Phase 1 complete; intake gate Approved for research scope.
expectedOutput: ≥3 Domain Candidates rows with Source = expireddomains.net.
acceptanceCriteria: Each row linked to same Project Run and Site; no purchase actions performed.
requiredEvidence: CSV export filename/date in Notes; filter screenshot optional.
completionCondition: Domain Candidates count ≥ 3 for the run.

title: Historical / Wayback review per candidate
instructions: For each Domain Candidate open web.archive.org and registrar history notes. Record Wayback Last Good date if clean; set Status = Blocked if spam/malware history. Document findings in Notes.
expectedOutput: Every candidate has Notes with history summary.
acceptanceCriteria: Blocked candidates must not proceed to Phase 3 selection.
requiredEvidence: Wayback URL pasted in Notes per candidate.
completionCondition: No candidate remains Not started without Notes.

title: Relevance scoring and rank
instructions: Score topical fit (1–5) in Notes; optional Ahrefs DR in Ahrefs DR field if tool available. Mark top candidate Status = In progress; others remain Not started or Blocked.
expectedOutput: Single preferred candidate identified in Notes on Project Run.
acceptanceCriteria: Scoring rubric documented in CSN Knowledge TEMPLATE: Domain candidate evaluation.
requiredEvidence: Project Run Evidence URL or Notes listing ranked domain.
completionCondition: One candidate marked In progress as primary pick.

title: Request domain purchase Human Gate
instructions: Create Human Gates: Target Type = domain_candidate, Target External ID = csn:domain:{domain}:{runExternalId}, Scope = register specific domain at named registrar, Limits = max price USD. Status = Pending. STOP — do not purchase until Approved.
expectedOutput: Pending gate tied to one domain only.
acceptanceCriteria: Target External ID matches exactly one Domain Candidates row.
completionCondition: Gate exists and remains Pending until human purchase approval.

title: Confirm domain purchase gate status
instructions: Verify Human Gate for domain_candidate is Approved before any registrar checkout. If Pending or Rejected, stop and escalate.
expectedOutput: Gate Status documented on Project Run Notes.
acceptanceCriteria: No registrar payment without Approved gate (policy control; not API-enforced).
completionCondition: For sandbox: gate may remain Pending and operator documents STOP. For prod: must be Approved.

title: Document selection rationale
instructions: Update winning Domain Candidates Notes with rationale; set Project Run Current Phase = 3.
expectedOutput: Rationale paragraph in Notion.
acceptanceCriteria: References scoring from Phase 2.
completionCondition: Notes length > 50 chars with decision summary.

title: DNS and hosting plan in CSN Knowledge
instructions: Create or update CSN Knowledge runbook entry for the site: DNS records, Cloudflare Pages project name, apex vs www. Link from Project Run Evidence URL.
expectedOutput: Knowledge article Category = Runbook linked to Site.
acceptanceCriteria: No secrets in article; only hostnames and record types.
completionCondition: Article Status = Done or In progress with complete DNS table.

title: Sandbox DNS checklist (no prod cutover)
instructions: Document sandbox/staging hostnames only. Do not change production DNS for QA test-only sites.
expectedOutput: Checklist in Knowledge or Project Run Notes.
acceptanceCriteria: QA test-only sites use example.com or staging subdomain only.
requiredEvidence: Notes stating no prod DNS change.
completionCondition: Checklist marked complete in Notes.

title: Repository and branch strategy
instructions: Document GitHub repo URL on CSN Sites Notes or Knowledge. Create CSN Releases row Environment = sandbox, Status = Not started, Git SHA when available.
expectedOutput: CSN Releases row linked to Site and Project Run.
acceptanceCriteria: Repo URL is public https GitHub link.
completionCondition: At least one CSN Releases row exists for run.

title: CI workflow verification (repo)
instructions: In GitHub: confirm workflow runs lint/test on PR. Record workflow URL in Release Notes or Knowledge. Command locally: npm run lint && npm test (if applicable).
expectedOutput: CI green on main or PR link stored.
acceptanceCriteria: Do not claim success without a workflow run URL.
requiredEvidence: GitHub Actions run URL in Notion rich text.
completionCondition: Evidence URL or Release Notes contains Actions link.

title: Document affiliate credential storage (outside Notion)
instructions: Record in CSN Knowledge: CrakRevenue / HasOffers keys live in GitHub Actions secrets (CRAKREVENUE_API_KEY) and Cloudflare env — never in Notion. Link to repo docs/CLOUDFLARE-DEPLOY-AUTH.md if present.
expectedOutput: Knowledge Policy article listing secret names only (not values).
acceptanceCriteria: No API keys pasted into any Notion property.
completionCondition: Article mentions GitHub Secrets + Cloudflare as sole stores.

title: Log Feed Sync Run
instructions: After a feed job runs (or simulated sandbox): create Feed Sync Runs row with Feed Provider, Started/Finished, Rows Upserted, link Site + Project Run.
expectedOutput: Feed Sync Runs row Status = Done for sandbox simulation.
acceptanceCriteria: Sandbox may use Rows Upserted = 0 with Notes 'simulated'.
completionCondition: Feed Sync Runs row exists for run.

title: Compliance page checklist
instructions: Create CSN Knowledge checklist: age gate, 2257, privacy, terms. Link Site relation. Mark gaps in Issues via CSN Incidents if blocking.
expectedOutput: Knowledge article Category = Policy.
acceptanceCriteria: Each required page listed with owner.
completionCondition: Checklist Status = In progress minimum.

title: Import SEO Opportunities
instructions: From GSC or manual research create SEO Opportunities rows with Target URL, Priority, link Site + Project Run.
prerequisites: Staging or prod URL known (sandbox: example URL).
expectedOutput: ≥2 SEO Opportunities rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Unverified if GSC API not run — note in Notes.
completionCondition: ≥2 rows created.

title: Sitemap submission plan
instructions: Document sitemap URL and GSC submission steps in Knowledge. Do not claim submitted unless verified in GSC UI.
expectedOutput: Runbook steps in Knowledge.
acceptanceCriteria: Marked Unverified until GSC confirmation captured.
completionCondition: Steps documented.

title: Identify backlink opportunity
instructions: Create Backlink Opportunities row with Target, DR/Traffic notes, Outreach Status = Identified.
expectedOutput: Backlink Opportunities row linked to run.
acceptanceCriteria: No outreach sent without gate for paid links.
completionCondition: Row exists.

title: Request paid backlink Human Gate
instructions: Human Gates: Target Type = backlink, Target External ID = csn:backlink:{id}, Scope = single placement, Limits = max USD. Status = Pending. STOP before payment.
expectedOutput: Pending gate separate from domain/production gates.
acceptanceCriteria: Limits field includes dollar cap.
completionCondition: Gate Status = Pending (not approved in this automation).

title: Staging release record
instructions: CSN Releases: Environment = staging, Status = In progress → Done when deploy completes. Git SHA required. Relate Site + Project Run.
expectedOutput: Staging release row with Deployed At.
acceptanceCriteria: QA sites use Environment = staging or sandbox only.
requiredEvidence: Release URL + deploy log link in Notes.
completionCondition: Release Status = Done for sandbox simulation.

title: Staging deploy Human Gate (if external impact)
instructions: If staging uses real DNS or public URLs with consequences: create Human Gates Target Type = staging_deploy (pending schema), Scope lists hostnames, Limits = no prod data. For QA-SANDBOX use example host only — gate optional but document.
expectedOutput: Gate row or explicit Notes 'no staging gate required for example.com QA'.
acceptanceCriteria: Gate not reused for production.
completionCondition: Documented decision.

title: Attach QA evidence to Project Run
instructions: Set Project Run Evidence URL to staging preview or test artifact. Current Phase = 10.
expectedOutput: Evidence URL non-empty.
acceptanceCriteria: URL must not assert production launch for QA Record Class.
completionCondition: Evidence URL populated.

title: Production deploy Human Gate
instructions: Create Human Gates Target Type = production_deploy, Target External ID = run External ID, Scope = prod hostnames, Limits = maintenance window. Status must be Pending until human approves. DO NOT deploy.
prerequisites: Staging evidence complete; Record Class = Production only.
expectedOutput: Pending production gate.
acceptanceCriteria: QA test-only sites skip this task (mark Done with Notes 'N/A QA').
completionCondition: Gate exists Pending or N/A documented for QA.

title: Production release row (blocked until gate)
instructions: CSN Releases Environment = production, Status = Blocked until production_deploy gate Approved. No deploy action in automation.
expectedOutput: Production release row in Blocked/Not started.
acceptanceCriteria: Git SHA empty until real deploy.
completionCondition: Row exists; not Done.

title: Launch KPI Snapshot (isolated DB)
instructions: Create Launch KPI Snapshots with metrics, Record Class matching site, link Site + Project Run. For QA use zeros and QA test-only. Legacy KPI History sync (npm run notion:sync-kpis) is separate — do not mix QA into hub KPI reporting.
expectedOutput: Snapshot row with Captured At.
acceptanceCriteria: Record Class must match site; production reporting must filter QA test-only.
completionCondition: Snapshot exists.

title: Seed CSN Maintenance routines
instructions: Create CSN Maintenance rows (weekly KPI review, feed health) linked to Site.
expectedOutput: ≥2 maintenance rows.
acceptanceCriteria: Cadence set.
completionCondition: ≥2 rows.

title: Close Project Run
instructions: Set Current Phase = 12, Status = Done only if Evidence URL set and required gates resolved or N/A for QA. Document handoff in Notes.
expectedOutput: Project Run Status = Done (sandbox) or In progress (prod pending gates).
acceptanceCriteria: Done without Evidence URL is policy violation — not API enforced.
completionCondition: Status updated per sandbox rules.
